cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report discloses demand deposits and bank deposits with maturity of three months or less, but does not split holding-company cash from operating-subsidiary cash. The group is mining-linked and later entered reporting delay/suspension, so the default group-cash discount is set near the conservative middle of 0.30-0.60/0.60-0.80 guidance rather than treating all cash as freely distributable.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially detachable only after retaining operating liquidity and resolving subsidiary/distribution uncertainty.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Private fund investment was originally fixed-return but was impaired and reclassified non-current; recovery and timing are uncertain, so it is not treated as cash-equivalent.
cash_breakdown.reason: Included only as a deeply discounted recoverable financial asset.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Finance lease liabilities are interest-bearing financing tied to mining machinery and are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Current and non-current lease liabilities payable total HK$47.578m.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Mining operation has material current liabilities, tax payable, royalties, inventory and receivables swings, and ongoing capex. With no precise parent/subsidiary cash split, HK$120m is retained for continued operation rather than detachable distribution.
cash_breakdown.reason: Current liabilities at 2023 year end were HK$313.518m and stripping all cash would leave a tight liquidity position.

profit_quality.assessment: Low to medium. The business can generate operating cash, but tin price cyclicality, large mine capex, working-capital swings, and the absence of audited 2024/2025 statements make a full-profit capitalization unsafe.
adjustments: 2021 parent profit was boosted by a HK$257.078m reversal of impairment on exploration and evaluation assets, so it is not used as a simple sustainable profit anchor.
2022 included fair value gain on derivative financial instruments and foreign exchange gain; 2023 profit fell to HK$68.390m attributable to owners.
Three-year post-capex free cash after PPE and exploration payments was HK$446.760m, -HK$24.623m and HK$43.686m, showing large capital reinvestment and cycle sensitivity.
Main pre-haircut distributable cash profit is set at HK$50m, close to recent post-capex cash rather than the 2021/2022 accounting profit peak.
A 0.55 profit haircut is applied for commodity cycle exposure, unclear maintenance capex, ongoing audit/reporting delays and trading suspension.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 operating cash flow was HK$238.889m, but PPE plus exploration cash spending was HK$195.203m; 2022 was negative on the same post-capex measure.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cycle industry with large recurring mine investment needs and unresolved reporting delay; cash conversion exists but is not stable enough to use reported net profit directly.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2023 operating cash flow exceeded parent net profit, but free cash after capex was only about HK$43.686m.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Annual reports disclose capex but not maintenance/growth split; main口径 treats heavy mine capex as requiring a large profit haircut.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 inventories, trade receivables and other receivables increased, partly offset by payables; net working-capital use was about HK$42.161m before tax effects.
